task.title: Pull request list, conversation and files
task.body:
Review on the phone. See [[Experience#pull-requests]].

- [ ] List with states, filter and open to-dos; shows once a pull request file exists
- [ ] Conversation: branches, ahead and behind, reviewers' verdicts, ready to merge, tasks, the file rendered with tickable to-dos
- [ ] Files: unified diff per file (side by side on tablets in landscape), threads under their lines, outdated ones marked
- [ ] Pull requests whose file is on another branch: read only, as on desktop
